newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in london firmer in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in london firmer in quiet trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks trading in London edged slightly higher in thin trade on Friday with buyers mainly focussing on technology and bank stocks, dealers said.
London's Nikkei ISE index finished 1.0 point higher at 1,429.28.
Bank stocks, which had shown some weakness overnight in Tokyo, staged a modest recovery in London.
Traders said buying interest was seen in NEC, which closed at 1,247.5 yen in London, down from a Tokyo close of 1,250.
"The market is firmer across the board," one trader said. "The futures were very strong and the U.S. inflation figures will help the market on Monday."

In Tokyo on Friday the key Nikkei 225 index rose 97.33 points to close at 20,968.16. Stocks advanced after drifting in a narrow range for most of the day after a national holiday on Thursday and ahead of the weekend.
"The market is fairly well capped at 21,000," a dealer said, adding that upside potential is limited by the uncertainty over the general elections due later this month.
